problem.formula: Z = SUM_{sigma_i} exp(beta SUM_{i,j} J_ij sigma_i sigma_j)
problem.description: 3D Edwards-Anderson spin glass on 16x16x16 lattice (4096 spins)
problem.classical_hardness: NP-hard: 2^N configurations to sum, N=4096 → 2^4096 terms
problem.quantum_approach: VQE approximates free energy F = -kT ln Z via ground state
